findings.title: Ubuntu CVE-2026-112816 advisory: improper certificate validation in Canonical LXD HTTPS listener
findings.summary_md: The Ubuntu security page lists publication date 30 October 2026 for CVE-2026-112816, describing improper certificate validation in the HTTPS listener in Canonical LXD versions 4.0.14, 5.0.10, 5.21.8 and earlier before 4.0.15, 5.0.11, 5.21.9, 6.10.1. It states an unauthenticated attacker who reaches the HTTPS API can authenticate as any trusted client and gain full cluster and VM access via a crafted certificate chain. Ubuntu rates it Medium priority.
